observations: Photo shows a disassembled vehicle gearbox/transmission assembly on the ground/inside a workshop.
No readable brand/model markings on the gearbox in the photo.
No visible label/plate with part number, VIN compatibility, or pin count.

claims.claim: Direct America drive Gearbox for GMC sierra V8 2008 14 15
claims.evidence: Photo does not show any readable compatibility markings/part number to confirm GMC Sierra V8 2008/2014/2015 fitment.
No test/bench run or performance evidence shown in the photo.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: Photo cannot confirm internal condition, mileage, whether it was opened, or whether it was tested/no-knock.

risks.risk: Wrong fitment (year/model/engine variant mismatch) or wrong transmission type (e.g., pin count/gear configuration).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the gearbox identification plate/label (part number) and the transmission tag, plus a photo showing the connector/pin count (if applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as a generic used gearbox with unknown fitment.

risks.risk: Not actually working / internal damage (no-knock claim not verifiable remotely).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the gearbox being tested (engaged in gear / running test) or a mechanic’s test report with sound/operation.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as not proven working.

risks.risk: Missing parts or incomplete kit (solenoids, sensors, torque converter, harness/valve body components).
risks.proof: Ask for a full inventory photo: all loose components laid out + confirmation of what is included (torque converter, flexplate, sensors, wiring harness, cooler lines, bolts).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as incomplete/unknown completeness.

risks.risk: Condition issues from handling/storage (leaks, bent shafts, damaged housings).
risks.proof: Ask for close-ups of input/output shaft ends, mounting points, and any visible leak points/corrosion.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as used with possible wear.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the gearbox identification plate/tag showing part number and compatibility.
Photo showing connector/pin count and any model-specific markings (if present).
Short video of the gearbox test/operation (or mechanic test report) showing it engages without abnormal noise.
Inventory/inclusion list with photos of all components included (torque converter, sensors/solenoids, harness, bolts, etc.).
response.reason: The photo shows a gearbox assembly but no readable identification or test evidence, so the claimed GMC Sierra V8 compatibility and “tested/working” status cannot be verified remotely. Without the part number/fitment proof, a worst-case price selection would be unreliable.
